program.description: I completed the Central Texas Food Bank's Warehouse Operations Program, learning how food moves through a warehouse: from receiving and inventory to shipping and delivery. I'd spent years building digital systems around information. I wanted to understand the physical operation those systems are supposed to represent.

stream.label: Writing
stream.item: I'm working through inventory and supply-chain problems, looking at what the models capture, what they leave out, and what institutional theory can tell us about the difference.

stream.label: Reading
stream.item: The Perfectionist's Guide to Losing Control

stream.label: Volunteering
stream.item: Planting baby trees, spring pruning, spreading mulch, and (always) picking up (more) trash. Next up: It's My Park Day!
